posts.title: April 2026 Update
posts.description: Da Nang, Vietnam 🇻🇳 In my last update, I mentioned heading to Da Nang to apply for a long-term Thai visa (spoiler: I got it 🎉, more below). posts.title: Sacred Mornings
posts.description: Simple mornings are one of life’s greatest luxuries. I like to start the day on my own terms, unhurried and undisturbed. No food before noon. Only two black coffees. No meetings before noon. No flights before 1 PM. No workouts either. Just a quiet walk. Not for fitness, but for thinking.
